'''Reflections IV''' is the first of three releases of [[Virtual Block 6]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 4 September 2009.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 110 cards: 59 Dark Side and 51 Light Side.

The cover lists text updates to [[Strong Is Vader]] and [[Lone Pilot (V)]].

== Discrepancies ==
* The release cover's heading misprints the block as "Virtual Set 6"; the other Virtual Block covers read "Virtual Block".<ref name="pdf" />
* The cover states that Rebel Fleet (V) was removed from this release, to be re-released in Virtual Set 7 after its text was changed and playtested.<ref name="pdf" /> It is not in any later release (7.1 to 9.2)<ref name="later">Virtual Block 7, 8 and 9 release PDFs ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf 7.1], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf 7.2], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf 7.3], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf 7.4], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf 8.1], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf 8.2], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf 8.3], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf 9.1], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf 9.2]), res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174522/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf 7.3], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174544/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf 8.1], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174637/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf 9.1] (Internet Archive).</ref> or in the 2013 virtual card master lists.<ref name="masters">[https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf ''Virtual Cards: Master List, Dark Side''] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf ''Light Side''] (official text as of April 27, 2013), Internet Archive.</ref>
* Another Pathetic Lifeform (V), a Light Side Defensive Shield, is printed in this release<ref name="pdf" /> but has no card page and is not in the [[Virtual Shields]] card list.
* [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V)]] and [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V) (Virtual Block 3)|Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V)]] are printed in this release.<ref name="pdf" /> The legacy card data places them in [[Virtual Block 5]] and [[Virtual Block 3]].<ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data).</ref><ref name="ll">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data).</ref>
* The ten Defensive Shields printed in this release are part of [[Virtual Shields]] in the legacy card data.<ref name="dl" /><ref name="ll" />
